messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [decision] Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- [observation] Dune noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-3)
- INC-2026-009: the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16; the root cause was two leaders elected during a network partition (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- [decision] Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run (since 2025-06-06; source standup/ember/2025-06-06)
- Cinder owns the scheduler (since 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-09-23-scheduler)
  - earlier: Dune owns the scheduler (held 2025-06-25 to 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-06-25-scheduler)
  - earlier: Ember owns the scheduler (held 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; source standup/ember/2025-01-20)
- [observation] Boreal noticed that the scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2)
- [decision] Decision: reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- [constraint] The scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC (since 2025-08-19; source standup/dune/2025-08-19)
  - earlier: [constraint] The scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC (held 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; source standup/ember/2025-02-06)
- [decision] Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- [decision] Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011 (since 2025-05-30; source incident-review/INC-2025-011)
- The handover note of 2025-06-11 wrongly recorded Cinder as the owner of the notifier (since 2025-06-27; source handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction)
- [observation] Ember noticed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy (since 2026-05-28; source standup/ember/2026-05-28)
- [constraint] No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11)
- Cinder owns the ledger (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
  - earlier: Atlas owns the ledger (held 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; source standup/atlas/2025-01-08)
- [observation] Atlas noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- [observation] Dune noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-2)
- [decision] Decision: auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens (since 2026-01-30; source standup/cinder/2026-01-30)
- The scheduler depends on feature-flags (since 2025-02-07; source standup/ember/2025-02-07)
- [constraint] No deploys to billing-api from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season (since 2025-11-11; source standup/atlas/2025-11-11)
- Marcus is a member of Atlas (since 2026-03-20; source standup/boreal/2026-03-20)
  - earlier: Marcus is a member of Boreal (held 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; source standup/boreal/2025-01-07)
